jurisdiction.name: Mozambique
jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: Mozambique has no AI law and no adopted AI strategy. The 2024 Science, Technology and Innovation Policy calls for a national AI strategy aligned with ethics, and the national ICT institute's (INTIC) draft National AI Strategy 2026-2031 has been in public consultation since May 2026. Draft strategies on digital transformation, cybersecurity (covering AI risks and deepfakes) and data governance (covering AI and sandboxes) are also out for consultation. A National AI Commission was reportedly created in 2026, but its founding text is not online.
lead_institutions: Instituto Nacional de Tecnologias de Informação e Comunicação (INTIC)
Ministry of Communications and Digital Transformation
narrative.review_notes: This review was carried out on 12 October 2026 from documents read in full on the ICT institute's website. The official gazette site and the science, education and health ministries' websites could not be accessed, so the decree creating the National AI Commission and the 2026 cybersecurity and cybercrime laws could not be read. As a large country with few records, Mozambique is marked for a longer catch-up pass.

instruments.official_title: Proposta da Estratégia Nacional de Inteligência Artificial de Moçambique (ENIA) 2026–2031
instruments.english_title: Proposal for the National Artificial Intelligence Strategy of Mozambique (ENIA) 2026–2031
instruments.issuing_authority: National Institute of Information and Communication Technologies (INTIC), for the Government of Mozambique
instruments.current_status: Not adopted. INTIC published the first version of the proposal for public consultation on 5 May 2026; the consultation page now links 'Proposta (Draft 6) da ENIA' (uploaded August 2026) and states contributions are due by 4 September (the INTIC consultation hub also lists an earlier 'Draft 2'). The page also mentions a PDF version, but only the Word file is linked. As of 11 October 2026 no adopting Council of Ministers resolution was found; the draft's preface is still a placeholder.
instruments.summary: Draft national AI strategy for 2026-2031, built around six pillars (science, infrastructure and ecosystem; social applications and human development; digital economy and industry; security, resilience and environmental sustainability; fundamental rights, information and democracy; AI governance, trust and supervision), with an action plan and budget annex. It proposes a national AI governance model centred on the National AI Commission (CNIA) with INTIC as ICT regulator and executive secretariat, a National AI Governance and Trust Framework (QNGC-IA), a national risk classification for AI systems, national and sectoral AI regulatory sandboxes, a national AI testing and audit centre, an AI observatory and a future Mozambican AI law.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: First national AI strategy, in public consultation; sets out the planned institutional and regulatory model for AI.
instruments.publisher_name: National Institute of Information and Communication Technologies
instruments.evidence_reference: curl (browser user agent, --max-time 60): INTIC consultation page read (dated 5 May 2026) and the full Draft 6 Word document downloaded and read (text extracted from the .docx).

instruments.official_title: Resolução n.º 39/2024, de 23 de Julho, que aprova a Política de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação e a Estratégia de Implementação
instruments.english_title: Resolution No. 39/2024 of 23 July approving the Science, Technology and Innovation Policy and its Implementation Strategy
instruments.current_status: Adopted and current. Copy of the Boletim da República issue hosted by INTIC (a state body) on its 'Políticas e Estratégias' page; the file name mislabels it as the Five-Year Government Programme, but the content is BR I Série n.º 142 of 23 July 2024 with Resolution 39/2024.
instruments.summary: Council of Ministers resolution (approved 21 May 2024, published in Boletim da República I Série n.º 142 of 23 July 2024) adopting the Science, Technology and Innovation Policy (PCTI) and its implementation strategy, revoking Resolution 23/2003. Under the pillar on capacity to use frontier and emerging technologies, strategic intervention iv is the development of a national AI strategy aligned with ethics, which the Government must ensure covers safety, transparency, credibility and the ethical use of AI; it also calls for a national Fourth Industrial Revolution strategy.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: The adopted policy mandate for a national AI strategy; the draft ENIA cites it as its basis.
instruments.evidence_reference: curl (browser user agent, --max-time 60): full Boletim da República PDF downloaded and read (pdftotext); resolution number, dates and the AI-strategy intervention confirmed in the text.

instruments.official_title: Estratégia Nacional de Transformação Digital (ENTD) – Versão Draft
instruments.english_title: National Digital Transformation Strategy (ENTD) – Draft Version
instruments.issuing_authority: Ministry of Communications and Digital Transformation (consultation run by INTIC)
instruments.current_status: Not adopted; posted on the INTIC consultation hub ('Propostas de Lei em Curso') in September 2026. The cover reads 'Versão Draft (22 de agosto 09 de julho de 2026)' (unresolved tracked edit); 22 August 2026 is recorded, matching the file name.
instruments.summary: Draft national digital transformation strategy prepared by the Ministry of Communications and Digital Transformation with ITU technical assistance, structured around five transformative changes (connected, served, productive, empowered, protected) and six implementation pillars. Its guiding objectives include using AI and emerging technologies responsibly to strengthen service delivery, governance, productivity, innovation and resilience, and it sets a target of at least 5,000 professionals trained in AI, data science and cybersecurity.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Digital strategy draft with an AI objective; the draft ENIA is meant to sit within it.
instruments.publisher_name: Ministry of Communications and Digital Transformation
instruments.evidence_reference: curl (browser user agent, --max-time 60): INTIC consultation hub page read and the full draft Word document downloaded and read (text extracted).

instruments.official_title: Proposta da Estratégia Nacional de Segurança Cibernética 2026–2030
instruments.english_title: Proposal for the National Cybersecurity Strategy 2026–2030
instruments.issuing_authority: National Institute of Information and Communication Technologies (INTIC)
instruments.current_status: Not adopted; version 0 posted on the INTIC consultation hub. The document itself carries no date; the month is from the official upload path (2026/09) and the file name's version stamp (20092026).
instruments.summary: Draft strategy (version 0) implementing the Cybersecurity Law (Law 13/2026), replacing the 2021-2025 strategy with priorities, initiatives, indicators and financing for 2026-2030. Initiative IV.5 provides for building technical capacity, verification protocols and a coordinated response to AI risks, deepfakes and disinformation by 2028, led by the national CSIRT (nCSIRT.MZ) with INTIC, the media, academia and electoral bodies, measured by operational capacity for AI risks, cases analysed and alerts issued.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Only national cyber-security document found with an AI-specific initiative (AI risks and deepfakes).
instruments.publisher_name: National Institute of Information and Communication Technologies
instruments.evidence_reference: curl (browser user agent, --max-time 60): INTIC consultation hub page read and the full draft Word document downloaded and read (text extracted).

instruments.official_title: Proposta de Política Nacional de Governação de Dados e a sua Estratégia de Implementação
instruments.english_title: Proposed National Data Governance Policy and its Implementation Strategy
instruments.issuing_authority: National Institute of Information and Communication Technologies (INTIC), with UNECA support, for approval by the Council of Ministers
instruments.current_status: Not adopted (resolution number left blank). An English 'Zero Draft 2' (November 2025) and a Portuguese final draft (December 2025) are on INTIC's data governance page; the version posted on the consultation hub is v280426. No date is stated in the document; only the year is recorded.
instruments.summary: Draft Council of Ministers resolution and policy setting a national data governance framework (data sovereignty, sharing, quality and institutional oversight). It treats the national AI strategy as a strategic vector of data governance, recognising that AI is fuelled by data, proposes standing or ad hoc subcommittees for fast-moving areas such as AI in health, and defines regulatory sandboxes in which data-driven innovations, including AI applications, are tested under supervision.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Data framework the AI strategy depends on; Mozambique has no general personal data protection law yet.
instruments.publisher_name: National Institute of Information and Communication Technologies
instruments.evidence_reference: curl (browser user agent, --max-time 60): INTIC data-governance page and consultation hub read; the v280426 and December 2025 Portuguese Word documents downloaded and read (text extracted).

leads.title: Decreto n.º 14/2026, de 17 de Abril (cria a Comissão Nacional de Inteligência Artificial – CNIA)
leads.english_title: Decree No. 14/2026 of 17 April creating the National Commission for Artificial Intelligence (CNIA)
leads.note: Cited in the draft ENIA (table 'Bloco 3', Decreto n.º 14/2026, 17/04/2026; the draft's text elsewhere calls it 'Resolução n. 14/2026'). INTIC news of 11 March 2026 reports the Council of Ministers' 7th ordinary session approved the CNIA (ethical principles, opinions and technical guidance, risk assessment). Official Boletim da República text not found online: the Imprensa Nacional site was unreachable (curl CONNECT 502; WebFetch DNS failure) and INTIC/portaldogoverno host no copy. Record as binding_regulation / government-governance when the gazette text is available; confirm decree vs resolution.
